data.why: The repo ships sample-records.ris, a small RIS citation set matching the app's RIS import format, and the app also has a built-in BCG vaccine example dataset reachable from its own Quick Start wizard/Help menu for meta-analysis testing.

goals: Import a batch of citation records (RIS/BibTeX/CSV) and screen titles/abstracts for inclusion or exclusion using keyboard shortcuts
Resolve screener disagreements via dual-screening conflict detection and compute inter-rater reliability (Cohen's Kappa)
Extract structured study data (design, population, intervention, outcomes, effect sizes) with provenance tracking
Assess risk of bias with RoB 2.0 signaling questions and produce a traffic-light summary plot
Pool extracted effect sizes into a random-effects meta-analysis and generate a forest plot with heterogeneity statistics
Check for publication bias with a funnel plot, Egger's test, and Trim-and-Fill, then export a PRISMA 2020 flow diagram

review.summary: The tree has the right shape for a systematic-review workbench, and its synthesis half (pooling, forest plot, sensitivity, funnel plot, PRISMA) is well evidenced. But the defining activity, screening each record, is missing, and several screening and RoB tasks are filed as working when their screens show failed or degenerate results. It needs those gaps and flags fixed before filing.
